title: narcissus autumnalis subsp. obsoletus
intro: Narcissus autumnalis subsp. obsoletus, commonly known as autumnal daffodil or autumnal narcissus, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus autumnalis subsp. obsoletus include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as galantamine and lycorine, which have been shown to possess neuroprotective and anti-inflammatory effects.
